title: Unfranked messages in an AbuseReport: INVENTED abuse_extensions component 0xF020 unverified_abusive_messages
description:
protocol-07 §5.9 AbusiveMessage requires a Frank, so a message from a room without franking cannot be an AbusiveMessage. Mark 2026-11-18: allow reporting them, marked unverified, and let the hub decide.

Readings: (a) refuse to report unfranked messages (the previous state, decision mimid-1wgh.59); (b) put them in messages with a zero or empty Frank (a hub would try to verify it and refuse the whole report 422, and the bytes lie about being a frank); (c) carry them in the AbuseReport's abuse_extensions, the AppDataDictionary §5.9 gives as an extension point, under a private-use component id.

Chosen (c). INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: component id 0xF020 (mls-extensions-11 §7.5: 0x8000-0xFFFF are for private use; not 0x?A?A, which the OpenMLS fork treats as GREASE; 0xF013 is the did:webvh heads record, decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.35, and 0xF014 appears in tests as an alternative to it), named unverified_abusive_messages. Its data, in the TLS presentation language:

struct { opaque message_content<V>; uint64 accepted_timestamp; } UnverifiedAbusiveMessage;
struct { UnverifiedAbusiveMessage messages<V>; } UnverifiedAbusiveMessages;

message_content is the MLS application_data as received (as for AbusiveMessage, decision mimid-1wgh.6.66) and accepted_timestamp the hub's FanoutMessage timestamp; nothing in it is verifiable. Decoding refuses an empty list and more than MAX_UNVERIFIED_ABUSIVE_MESSAGES (64) entries. Franked messages keep going in messages. The type lives in mimi-protocol (abuse.rs) beside AbusiveMessage, marked INVENTED.

A hub that does not know 0xF020 skips it: abuse_extensions entries round-trip unchanged and are otherwise ignored. A mimid hub decodes it after the canReportAbuse check (decision mimid-1wgh.57); a malformed or oversized component is dropped with a log event, not a refusal (AGENTS.md: drop a malformed untrusted extension without failing the containing object). The franked messages are verified as before, and one that fails still refuses the report 422 (decision mimid-1wgh.6.65). The report is accepted and logged with verified (franks checked) and unverified (the component's entries, plus messages in a room without franking) counts; a report with only unverified messages is accepted as unverified. The report still names the reporter and one alleged abuser (decision mimid-1wgh.58 notes: never anonymous). The order between franked and unfranked messages is not kept.
notes: 2026-11-19 built on branch report-abuse-2: mimi-protocol component_id::UNVERIFIED_ABUSIVE_MESSAGES, UnverifiedAbusiveMessage(s), MAX_UNVERIFIED_ABUSIVE_MESSAGES, AbuseReport::unverified_messages; hub/abuse.rs logs verified and unverified counts (the old 'messages' and boolean 'verified' fields are gone); a malformed component is logged abuse_report_extension_dropped. README lists 0xF020 with mimid's private-use code points.
